title: TDD Workflow: How Far Does It Go?

scenes.say: Does test-driven development work for everything? Or does it have limits you should know about?
Here's the TDD cycle. First, write a test that fails. Next, add code to make it pass. Then, refactor to keep things clean.

scenes.label: Logic
scenes.sub: TDD shines with logic-heavy code and core features.
scenes.say: TDD works best for logic-heavy code, like business rules or core algorithms.

scenes.label: Limits
scenes.sub: UI and integration-heavy features may need other methods.
scenes.say: But for user interfaces or complex integrations, TDD can slow you down or miss important details.

scenes.question: Is TDD always the best choice?
scenes.right: No, adapt your approach for UI or integrations.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Is test-driven development always the best choice? Not really. Adapt your approach for user interfaces or integration-heavy features.
